title: Spectral minimal partitions of combinatorial graphs
summary: This paper investigates spectral minimal partitions for weighted graphs, thus extending the extensive class of results that are currently available on domains and, to a lesser extent, manifolds and metric graphs. We provide a rigorous framework for analyzing graph Laplacians under Dirichlet, Neumann, and boundaryless energy formulations; a central focus of the study is establishing existence theorems for minimal partitions.
